disposition_reason: Tables 1 to 3 print mean ± SD Pb, Cd and Ni in bulbs or fruit, leaves and whole plants of onion, garlic and chilli from polluted and non-polluted areas of Gazipur.

study.design: Field survey of spices grown in directly polluted, indirectly polluted and non-polluted areas, with rhizosphere soil
study.period_text: winter crop season; collection dates not reported
study.method: HNO3/HClO4 (5:1) digestion of 1 g at 190 C for 1.5 h; AAS (Varian)
study.qa: each sample analysed three times; no CRM or recovery reported
